start.speaker: Ivo
start.text: Both entries on the same line. Killed, killed. The vault kept books like that and look what it did to the vault.

r2.speaker: Ivo
r2.text: Four floors. I will file it under attempts. There is a whole drawer of attempts and it is the heaviest drawer.

r3.speaker: Ivo
r3.text: Cleared. I have entered it in ink. That is not something I do lightly and I would like you to know it.

r4.speaker: Ivo
r4.text: The vault. They sealed the quorum in with the measure. I was on the wrong side of the door and I have never been able to decide which side that was.

r5.speaker: Ivo
r5.text: Ten. I have a column for it now. I did not want to open the column.

quiet.speaker: Ivo
quiet.text: Everything you leave with me is entered. Everything entered is findable. It is the only useful thing I know how to do.
